name: PageHeader
purpose: The page's own header under the TopBar: title, description, meta, actions and section tabs. Not the global header; that is TopBar.
description: A compact secondary header on surface layer-1, full width at the top of the main area. The title is the page's h1. Actions sit on the right; the tabs slot takes a TabNav, which sticks below the TopBar for the whole page. Spacing follows the density mode.

description.default: Every invoice across your customers, newest first.

headingLevel.description: Heading element for the title. h1 unless the page already has one.
headingLevel.a11y: Each page has exactly one h1; PageHeader's title is usually it.

meta.description: Small context next to the title: a status Badge, an ID.

actions.description: Page actions: one primary Button and its secondaries.

tabs.description: A TabNav for the page's sections.

a11y.role: none (a plain region at the top of main; it never becomes a second banner landmark)
a11y.name: The title is the page's heading; the tabs landmark is named by TabNav's aria-label.
notes: The title renders as h1 by default so every page has exactly one top-level heading.
The sticky tab row sits below the TopBar (top-topbar), so focused tabs are never hidden behind it.

rules: One PageHeader per page, first inside main.
The title is the page's only h1.
At most one primary Button in actions; it is the page's primary action.
Use the tabs slot only with TabNav, and only when each section has its own URL.
dos: Put the record status in meta as a Badge: Invoices / INV-0041 [Overdue].
donts: Do not put filters in the PageHeader; they belong to the content area.

props.title: Invoices
